_about: What each unit was modelled on, in real life (real) and in films or games (media), keyed by balance.json vehicle id. Sources: Docs/DECISIONS.md (19R, 19U, 20V, 20Y, 21H), the Tools/blender builders' docstrings, each weapon's real name in balance.json, general knowledge. A note starting with 'ước đoán' marks a guess. build_doc.py shows it on every unit card.
